title: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
description: <cite index="51-3,51-4,51-5">These final guidelines amend the RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies — Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025, effective from 1 January 2027. The guidelines establish a comprehensive framework for conduct related matters in recovery of loan dues and engagement of recovery agencies.</cite>
